address: 42 Cyber Road, Outer Ring, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103

travelInfo.details: Nearest metro station is 1.5 km away. Feeder shuttles will run every 20 minutes on Dec 19 morning.
Outer Ring Road buses stop right outside the technology campus. Dedicated cab pick-up/drop-off zone at Gate 2.
Free covered two-wheeler and four-wheeler parking is available on-campus for registered participants.
